question: Evaluate $\begin{vmatrix}1&2&0\\3&1&2\\0&4&1\end{vmatrix}$ by expanding along the first row.
explanation:
Step 1: Expand along the first row
Using the signs $+$, $-$ and $+$, $$\begin{vmatrix}1&2&0\\3&1&2\\0&4&1\end{vmatrix}=1\begin{vmatrix}1&2\\4&1\end{vmatrix}-2\begin{vmatrix}3&2\\0&1\end{vmatrix}$$
Step 2: Evaluate the smaller determinants
We obtain $$\begin{vmatrix}1&2\\4&1\end{vmatrix}=1-8=-7$$ and $$\begin{vmatrix}3&2\\0&1\end{vmatrix}=3$$
Step 3: Substitute
The required value is $$-7-2(3)$$
Step 4: Simplify
Hence, the determinant equals $$-13$$
